dialect.detail: Standard COBOL-85 with no vendor-specific extensions visible; uses COMP-3, 88-level conditions, PERFORM VARYING, EVALUATE implied via IF chains, and Swedish-language comments. Likely compiled with GnuCOBOL or similar open-source compiler given the author credit and style.
evidence: no EXEC CICS or EXEC SQL

purpose.domain_detail: Sudoku solver implemented as a callable COBOL subprogram, written by Erik Weyler in 2013. Swedish comments throughout.
purpose.summary: This program (MDSMSDUS) is a Sudoku solver subprogram. It accepts an 81-character Sudoku grid, a side-length parameter, and returns the solved grid along with the number of guesses required. It uses candidate elimination and backtracking (guessing) to find a solution, returning a RETURN-CODE indicating success or failure.

notable_features: 88-level condition names used extensively as flags
Backtracking/guessing algorithm with up to 55 sudoku copies on stack
PERFORM VARYING with complex UNTIL conditions
LINKAGE SECTION with three parameters (p-sudoku, p-sdu-size, p-nr-of-guesses)
Exponentiation operator (**) used for square root check
No COPY statements, no SQL, no CICS
verdict.notes: All comments are in Swedish. The program is a self-contained subprogram with no COPY statements. The algorithm supports variable-size Sudoku grids (not just 9x9). Source truncated at 16000 chars but the structure is clear. Dialect is likely GnuCOBOL or similar free/open compiler given the author style and date (2013), but no definitive vendor evidence is present.
